basic_info.description: Magnificent Spanish Mediterranean home tucked away on prime block across from Santa Monica Park, close to West Portal Village! Lovely garden entrance w/walkway & mosaic tile landing leads to a fabulous arched portico entry & into a stunning foyer w/spectacular open-banister staircase & coat closet. Monumental formal living rm w/high ceiling & mahogany double doors boasts an imposing fireplace w/phenomenal original Batchelder tile surround, exquisite wall sconces, hardwood floors & picture windows w/views to the park. Majestic banquet-size formal dining rm w/splendid period wall sconces & dramatic chandelier! Updated kitchen w/butler's pantry, service corridor & huge, light-filled breakfast rm w/built-in corner china hutch features an open-beam ceiling, quartz counters, garden window & luxury flooring. A delightful office/5th bedroom en-suite & sep charming powder rm end this floor. Impressive circular staircase w/frosted glass windows ascends to the upper level landing w/handsome library bookshelves, 4BR & 2BA. Extraordinary master suite w/dressing rm, walk-in closets & gigantic vintage tile bath. The outstanding lower level incl a remarkable family rm, snack bar, wine rm, pantry, laundry rm, storage rm & potting rm. Beautifully landscaped front yard w/trees, brick patio & arbor!
